hero.title:
Organize.
Document.
Protect.
hero.body: One workspace for your projects, your knowledge and your credentials. Open to you and your AI agents, with permissions you control.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.body: Kanban boards, labels, due dates and checklists.

docs.title: Docs
docs.body: Nested Markdown pages, linked to your tasks.

vault.title: Vault
vault.body: End-to-end encrypted. Neither the server nor your agents can read it.

agents.title: Agents
agents.body: An MCP server with per-token permissions, so your LLMs can work alongside you.

orbit.label: Agents orbit your tasks and documents; the vault stays out of their reach

name.label: Your name
name.hint: Shown in the activity of your workspaces.

setup.title: Set up your copy
setup.subtitle: This copy of Orqevio is yours alone. Enter the setup code you chose when you installed it. If you didn’t choose one, you’ll find it in the server log.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Enter the access key for this copy of Orqevio.

recovery.intro: Whoever manages this copy can generate a new key:
recovery.withNewCode: With a new code: change SETUP_CODE in the copy’s configuration, restart it and enter the new code here.
recovery.vaultUnaffected: The vault isn’t affected: it stays protected by its master password.

setup.title: Save your access key
setup.subtitle: You’ll use it to sign in to this copy from any device. It’s shown only once, so save it in your password manager.

recovery.title: Your new access key
recovery.subtitle: The old key no longer works, and every session has been signed out. Save this one in your password manager: it’s shown only once.

keyReveal.label: Access key
keyReveal.saved: I’ve saved it somewhere safe, like my password manager.

keyFile.name: orqevio-access-key.txt
keyFile.title: Orqevio — Access key
keyFile.use: Save it in your password manager. It signs you in to this copy of Orqevio from any device.
keyFile.lost: If you lose it, whoever manages the copy can generate a new one. It doesn’t affect the vault’s master password.
